about.title: About Us
about.h3: China Jinba Used Car Export Platform
about.p1: China Jinba is a professional used car export company dedicated to providing quality vehicles and services to global customers.
about.p2: With extensive industry experience and a professional team, we partner with major automotive brands to offer diverse vehicle selections.
about.p3: Our services cover 50+ countries and regions including Russia, Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and South America. We have served over 1,000 international clients with strong reputation and trust.
